RPSC Statistical Officer Answer Key 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Rajasthan Public Service Commission (RPSC) has released the Answer Key for the post of Statistical Officer. This recruitment was released for 113 posts. Applications for Rajasthan RPSC Statistical Officer Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 28 October 2025 to 26 November 2025. The written examination was conducted on 30 October 2026. Candidates who had appeared in this examination can download their RPSC Statistical Officer Answer Key 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 14 October 2025
  • Application Start Date : 28 October 2025
  • Last Date : 26 November 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 26 November 2025
  • Exam Date : 30 August 2026
  • Exam City Details : 24 August 2026
  • Admit Card : 27 August 2026
  • Answer Key : 07 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, Other State : Rs. 600/-
  • OBC, BC : Rs. 400/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 400/-
  • Correction Charge : Rs. 500/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
